snippet.title: One Piece World Seeker – PS4/XB1/PC – Meet The Resistance (Tokyo Game Show trailer)
snippet.description:
Eiichiro Oda – the creator of One Piece was involved from the start of the creative process of One Piece World Seeker. He supervised the story of the game, and conceived two new original characters, Jeanne and Isaac, that will be the main focus of this new adventure of the Straw Hat Crew. 

Prison Island’s inhabitants are divided into two faction. On one side “The Pro-Navy” who accepted the Marine’s control and modernisation and on the other side the “Anti-Navy” who prize tradition. The two newly revealed characters embody this split. 

Isaac - the warden of the prison helped rebuild the island using science after a war nearly wiped it off entirely. 
Jeanne is an “Anti-Navy” and the leader of the rebellion. She loves the Island the way it used to be and swore to protect its inhabitants.

One Piece World Seeker is coming on PS4, XB1 and PC in 2019
